# Stratos Games

Stratos Games is an indie game studio and a game portal. Play free casual, puzzle, word and party games in your browser, made by the Stratos family and the studio. Humans test, AI builds, games ship.

## Play (free browser games)
- [Magic Shot](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza/): A magical liquid-sorting puzzle: pour glowing potions between enchanted bottles until every bottle holds one colour. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Aetherhold](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-aetherhold/): Build a kingdom on a floating sky island, summon heroes, raise an army and battle through a 30-stage campaign. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Cargo Climb](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-cargo-climb/): A hill-climb driving game where you haul three loose crates over the hills and get paid for every crate that reaches a depot. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Chroma Clash](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-chroma-clash/): A funky 3D color-matching card game: play bots, friends on one phone, or friends anywhere online. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Ink Velocity](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-ink-velocity/): Draw the road and send a red supercar across the Darjeeling hills, under real Kanchenjunga peaks. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Momo Run](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-momo-run/): A 3D endless runner: dash, jump and duck down a cobblestone road, solo or racing up to 3 friends online. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Plot Twist: Spot the Drama](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-plot-twist/): Spot the differences in soap-opera scenes: weddings, first dates, office meltdowns and more. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Wordbloom: Word Journey](https://stratos.games/play/im-mohua-liza-wordbloom/): Swipe letters to fill crossword grids across 8 dreamy worlds, from cherry blossoms to a starfall nebula. Made by Mohua Liza.
- [Arrow Rush](https://stratos.games/play/mody-sahariar1/): Clear every arrow off the board without a collision. 100 classic levels and 10 adventure worlds. Made by Sahariar Mody.
- [BridgeWorks Campus](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-bridge-genius/): Walk the campus road from Class 1 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then build a real-physics bridge and test it with traffic. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [FAILSPAN: Structural Mayhem](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-failspan/): Build real-physics bridges in 2D or 3D, from Class 1 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then test the bridge with traffic. Build. Stress. Snap. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [SkyForge](https://stratos.games/play/saiqulmodi-skyforge/): Fly a stealth fighter over real South India terrain and earn stars for every landing. Made by Md. Saiqul Haque Modi.
- [Skyfall Armada](https://stratos.games/play/shoaibul0926/): Command a flying warship, destroy enemy fleets, and rule the skies in fast-paced aerial battles. Made by Shoaibul Hoque.
- [Echo Island](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali/): Explore a living island, bond with creatures and rebuild its lost memory, where every choice changes the world. Made by Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Babel Harbour](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali-babel-harbour/): A calm daily word puzzle: sort the crates to the dock showing their true meaning and spot the false friends between German, French and English. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [BrainRush Daily](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali-brainrush/): Three quick brain puzzles every day, plus endless puzzle rounds and 30 levels of Gem Match. No sign-up. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Dino Frontier](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali-dino-frontier/): Survive the Frontier, discover eggs and evolve your dinosaur along one of three paths. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [DOMINO CLASSIC](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali-domino-classic/): Classic Draw and Block dominoes: play a friend online with a room code, or take on smart computer opponents. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [MOTO RUSH](https://stratos.games/play/sksarfarajali-moto-rush/): Race a 3D superbike through traffic, upgrade five bikes and beat three new challenges every day. Made by Sk Sarfaraj Ali.
- [Toot Raft](https://stratos.games/play/tamannamody/): Four pigs on a spinning raft, one spiky river, and nothing but toots to steer with. Made by Tamanna Tahseen.

## Coming soon (claimed by family makers)

## Studio titles
- [BLOXPLODE](https://stratos.games/games-bloxplode/): Combo block puzzle. Clear lines, chain combos, survive the 10-level Adventure.
- [Arrow Puzzle](https://stratos.games/games-arrow-puzzle/): Every arrow points somewhere. Clear the board without a collision.
- [House Mafia](https://stratos.games/games-house-mafia/): Mafia and Werewolf, set at a house party. 4 to 8 players, 3 to 5 minute rounds.
- [Word Quest](https://stratos.games/games-word-quest/): Drag across the grid, find the words, win the minute.
